description: This file contains unit tests for the AWS SQS streaming provider integration within an Orleans application. It tests functionality such as connecting to SQS streams, simulating client dropouts, and verifying streaming behavior from the client perspective.

classes.name: SQSClientStreamTests
classes.description: Test suite for SQS streaming using Orleans, focusing on producer and client dropout scenarios.

classes.name: MySiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures a silo to use SQS streams and in-memory storage.

classes.name: MyClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures a client to connect to SQS streams.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test cluster before running tests.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Sets up the silo and client configurations for the test cluster.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up resources after tests, including deleting SQS queues.

methods.name: SQSStreamProducerOnDroppedClientTest
methods.description: Test verifying behavior when a client drops from an SQS stream.
